paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: The influence of number of blanks to .
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy percentage as a function of the number of blanks. The x-axis, labeled "# Blanks," displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels indicating integer values from 1 to 6, spaced one unit apart. The y-axis, representing accuracy percentage, is scaled linearly from 0 to 70, with tick labels indicating increments of 10, starting at 0 and ending at 70. A single solid blue line represents the Qwen2.5-VL-72B model, beginning at approximately 63% at blank value 1 and decreasing to approximately 3% at blank value 6.
